routes.shape: weak local model composes SMT-LIB text directly from shared source-derived cue rows and a target encoding contract
weak local model maps both source-derived cue rows through one grammar-constrained pair JSON hop into route_rule_ir.v0; deterministic compiler emits SMT-LIB targets before verifier scoring
routes.schema_notes: schema.route_rule_ir.v0 fixture-scale cue rows compiled by route_rule_ir_v0_to_smt_v0
routes.bridge_notes: deterministic route_rule_ir.v0 to SMT-LIB bridge emits per-group route targets

routes.shape: model fills a compact stack of existing IR-shaped forms before deterministic compilation, e.g. source_frame -> rule_row -> route_rule_ir.v0
routes.schema_notes: schema.stacked_ir.v0 fixture-scale JSON object keyed by source label, with source_frame and rule_row stages before bridge
routes.bridge_notes: deterministic stacked_ir_v0_to_route_rule_ir_v0 bridge feeds the existing route_rule_ir_v0_to_smt_v0 compiler

routes.shape: model translates through several adjacent constrained JSON hops, each a deliberately small semantic delta before final route_rule_ir.v0 compilation
routes.runtime: project-local llama.cpp subprocess via tools/setup-local-model.mjs; three constrained JSON calls per route row
routes.schema_notes: schema.ir_hop_chain.v0 aggregate over lexical_cues, clinical_frame, and rule_rows hop schemas; each hop has prompt/response hashes
routes.bridge_notes: deterministic ir_hop_chain_v0_to_route_rule_ir_v0 bridge records hop lineage, then feeds the existing route_rule_ir_v0_to_smt_v0 compiler

routes.shape: model fills CKC-native stages per source label aligned to the fixture spine: segment-like spans, statement-like normalized facts, then rule-like route IR
routes.runtime: project-local llama.cpp subprocess via tools/setup-local-model.mjs; one constrained JSON call per source label per CKC stage
routes.schema_notes: schema.ckc_layered.v0 aggregate over segment, statement, and rule stage schemas aligned to the CKC fixture spine
routes.bridge_notes: deterministic ckc_layered_v0_to_route_rule_ir_v0 bridge preserves stage lineage, then feeds the existing route_rule_ir_v0_to_smt_v0 compiler

routes.shape: extends route.ckc_layered: after the layered CKC stages bridge and compile, intrinsic schema, grounding, bridge, and SMT-syntax residuals are fed back for bounded rule-stage revision, then re-bridged
routes.runtime: project-local llama.cpp subprocess via tools/setup-local-model.mjs; the ckc_layered base calls plus up to two rule-stage repair calls per source label, with attempts selected on well-formedness only
routes.schema_notes: reuses schema.ckc_layered.v0; repair calls are constrained to the same stage3.rules schema
routes.bridge_notes: reuses the ckc_layered_v0_to_route_rule_ir_v0 bridge and route_rule_ir_v0_to_smt_v0 compiler; gold-coupled false_positive/false_negative residuals are withheld from repair feedback so the loop never learns the expected verdict
